Taunt disables Sinistcha’s Rage Powder, Strength Sap, and Protect. Preserve Politoed when reserves remain so Drizzle can overwrite sand and disable Sand Rush. Tsareena’s Wide Lens makes Low Kick and Power Whip more reliable; Low Kick is decisive into Tyranitar. Knock Off provides strong Ghost pressure into Gholdengo and Sinistcha. Avoid centering plans on Mega Delphox in rain; delay evolution until Tyranitar is controlled. Tailwind enables Politoed and Tsareena to overcome typical opposing Speed ranges.

reflections.summary: Won by grinding with Sinistcha: repeated Matcha Gotcha into Politoed (super effective, self-healing, and burning Tsareena via secondary/contact chip) meant Sinistcha never dropped below ~73% while both Politoed and Tsareena were whittled down by burn plus sand. Tyranitar's entry also flipped Politoed's rain to sandstorm, blanking Weather Ball's water mode and adding residual damage. reflections.adjustment: Treat Tyranitar as a one-turn weather button, not a body: bring it in only to overwrite rain, then immediately pivot out or sac it deliberately to gain a free Rotom-Heat switch — never leave it in front of Tsareena (Low Kick OHKO). If they again bring Tsareena + Politoed, consider swapping Gholdengo for a fourth that pressures Grass/Water directly, and open Sinistcha + Rotom-Heat so Matcha Gotcha stall starts on turn 1 with the Tsareena answer already on the field instead of held in reserve.

reflections.summary: The no-Mega rain four handled Tyranitar and Gholdengo but lacked a durable way to finish Sinistcha plus Rotom-Heat. Sinistcha’s repeated Matcha Gotcha recovery and burn left Tsareena unable to close, while Rotom-Heat resisted Power Whip and secured the endgame.
reflections.adjustment: Bring Mega Delphox over Basculegion, retain Whimsicott to Taunt Sinistcha, and delay Mega Evolution until Tyranitar is controlled and rain is no longer suppressing the Fire matchup.
reflections.notebook: Opponent uses Sinistcha as a sustained damage-and-recovery centerpiece, including beside Protecting Tyranitar and in a Rotom-Heat endgame. Prioritize Taunt on Sinistcha; Grass attackers can bypass Rage Powder. Preserve Politoed to overwrite sand when needed. Tsareena’s Low Kick is the primary Tyranitar answer and Knock Off pressures opposing Ghosts. Consider Mega Delphox over Basculegion for this matchup, evolving only after Tyranitar is controlled and rain timing is favorable.
